svg.text: Shortcuts + dynamic key lighting · AZERTY positions
Fn focus: only useful keys stay lit. Customize colors and modules in Studio.
Fn + CAL → Fn + 1 / 2 / 3: record into a slot
Fn + CAL: finish and keep the sequence
Fn + Shift + 1 / 2 / 3: loop; same shortcut = stop
Hold: step repeatedly; release: keep selected speed
Fn + T, then a key: choose the repeat target
Fn + T → VOL− / VOL+: left / right click
Click: amber / purple · E / F / Space: quick Turbo
Esc or a normal target press: stop
Fn + F2 / F3 / F4: white / red / Off
Fn + F5: automatic startup wave on / off
Fn + F6: four media-key white fallback
Fn + F7: white / dark idle fallback
Fn + WIN: lock (red keys + status LED)
Fn + ESC: stop; hold 2 s: bootloader
−/+ adjusts the last selected function: Recorder = speed; Turbo = rate. Fn + R selects Turbo.
CAL + FN breathe: red = recording · green = one-shot · cyan = loop · amber = selection / limit
3 shared RAM slots · about 48 simple presses total · 30 s maximum · cleared at USB reset/disconnect
F8 keeps recordings; F9 saves lighting only, not the temporary recordings.
After 5 s without RGB: CAPS green when active · SCROLL amber when active
NUM on: white numpad + green NUM · NUM off: very dim white numpad
Live RGB takes priority over CAPS/NUM/SCROLL. Lighting Off and USB suspension stay authoritative.
Red Blade Full Size ISO · 4 media keys · Normal typing and media functions are preserved
Upper-right Windows indicator: on = Windows keys locked; holding Fn alone does not turn it on.
